author: kevin-valerio

title: Cargo will lose inter-process file locking on Solaris on with 1.98-nightly
author: weihanglo
body_preview: ### Problem  Cargo will lose inter-process file locking on Solaris starting with 1.98-nightly tomorrow.  `std::fs::File::lock` and friends were emulated on Solaris via `fcntl` from 1.91 (rust-lang/rust#146269) but removed in 1.98 (rust-lang/rust#157509) because the emulation is process-scoped instead of handle-scoped.
